source.source_title: Make Art Feel Better with Billie Bivins: Whittling Wood
source.why_this_clip: An acoustic guitar leans against a chair, seen from the front with the neck rising up and to the right. The guitar itself is still; from 6.5 s the camera tilts and pans so the guitar slides down and right in frame. The clip has no cuts, and this interval keeps the whole body in frame while the camera move happens; after 8.0 s the body leaves the bottom of the frame.
